verses: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ

Only in Sayings on the poor, the king's wrath and the sluggard: A man's folly ruins his way and his heart rages against YHWH; A son who ruins his father and chases away his mother brings shame; He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from YHWH; a prudent wife is from YHWH; Giving as a loan to God, repaid by him [divergence between the texts]; The king's wrath is like the growling of a young lion; his favor like dew on the grass; Whatever misfortune strikes people is for what their own hands have earned, though God pardons much; A quarrelsome wife is like a continual dripping (of a leaking roof); The sluggard buries his hand in the dish and will not even bring it back to his mouth; Strike a scoffer and the simple will learn prudence; The poor is hated even by his neighbor, but the rich has many friends; A rod is for the back of the fool (the senseless); The slow to anger is better than a mighty man, and he who rules his spirit than he who takes a city; and 6 more.

Only in Al-Taghabun: forms made beautiful, the Day of Mutual Loss, enemies among wives and children, and the goodly loan: The Day of Gathering is the Day of Mutual Dispossession / Loss and Gain (yawm al-taghabun); Among your spouses and children are enemies to you, so beware of them; yet if you pardon and forgive, God is forgiving; Fear God as much as you are able (ma stata'tum); No calamity strikes except by God's leave; whoever believes, God guides his heart; Unbelievers rejected their messengers saying 'Shall mere humans guide us?'; God created you, and among you are unbelievers and believers; Son dishonors father, daughter rises against mother, daughter-in-law against mother-in-law; a man's enemies are his own household; Son dishonors father, daughter rises against mother, daughter-in-law against mother-in-law; a man's enemies are his own household [divergence between the texts]; God shaped you and made your forms good (sawwarakum fa-ahsana suwarakum); The poor emigrants and the hosts who prefer others over themselves even in need; whoever is saved from his own greed succeeds; The Day of Gathering (yawm al-jam') when all humanity is assembled; one party to the Garden, one to the Blaze; Wealth and children are a trial (fitna); and 6 more.

Only in Psalm 44 - national lament; why do you sleep, O Lord: Our fathers told us what you did in their days: you dispossessed nations and planted them; God made his people a byword (mashal) among nations, a shaking of the head among peoples; God crushed them in the place of jackals (tannim) and covered them with deep darkness; For your sake we are killed all day long, counted as sheep for slaughter; All this came upon us though we have not forgotten you nor been false to your covenant; God sold his people for no price and scattered them among the nations; 'Awake! Why do you sleep, O Lord?'; Explaining a military defeat of God's people [contrast between the texts]; The petitioner addresses God as 'my King and my God'; God knows the treachery of the eyes and what the breasts conceal; They did not win the land by their sword but by God's right hand, arm and the light of his face; The petitioner spreads out his palms toward God; and 8 more.
